target_rule: >=10 mapped q<.05 DE targets, up/down separately; paired patient design and full patient-omission refits
expression_rule: same case-histology patient, fixed source label and receiver >=50 cells and every complex subunit >=10% detection, >=3 supporting patients; omission support rechecked
score: official unsigned prior Pearson statistic, descriptive ranks; down-target fit not causal inhibition
assay_source: all assayed genes in exact patient/histology pseudobulks, not the targeted LR panel
